verdict.rationale: Supabase documents automatic daily backups for Pro, Team, and Enterprise projects, which covers the 'automatic backups on a schedule' core. Nothing in the pack shows the schedule can be viewed or configured, or that restores are self-serve. A community report says the nightly pg_dump backups took one user's database offline; that is a limitation of the backup feature, not proof it doesn't exist, so it is not a dispute. Supabase Cron is a general job scheduler, not a backup feature, and is not credited. Missing for 10: user-configurable backup schedule/visibility, self-serve restore workflow, backup coverage on the Free plan, independent corroboration of reliable backups.

support.subject: As a founder, automatic backups run on a schedule I can see and configure, and restores are self-serve

citations.quote: We automatically back up all Pro, Team, and Enterprise Plan projects on a daily basis.
